**1 — Scene:** Two dishes: a thick, cheese-topped pizza square and stir-fried noodles with beef and vegetables. Both plates are included; water is excluded from the food estimate.

**2 — Vessels:** Left plate approximately 20 cm diameter, area **314 cm²**. Right plate approximately 18 cm diameter, area **254 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Pizza with cheese and dark vegetable toppings; noodles; beef strips; small amounts of vegetables; brown sauce/oil coating. Pizza toppings are included in the pizza estimate.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Coverage percentages refer to each item's own plate. Sauce is incorporated into the noodle dish’s energy density rather than counted as a separate overlapping volume.

| Beef strips | 15% right | 38 × 1.3 = 49 ml | 1.0 → 49 g | 230 | 113 kcal |
| Cooked vegetables | 5% right | 13 × 1.5 = 20 ml | 0.6 → 12 g | 50 | 6 kcal |

**Coverage check:** Approximately 40% of the left plate and 68% of the right plate are covered by food.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **426 g and 920 kcal** is plausible for the visible thick pizza square and modest mound of beef noodles. Thickness and cooking oil are the main uncertainties.
